gen-gf-turret-road-gf-cairo-play: Turret Road draws its round forms like open parentheses, one pen-like line of constant weight, bold and commanding up top. Cairo Play keeps the text open and easy to follow.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-cambay: Cambay lets its rounds gap like a cracked bangle, a contemporary plain sans under Turret Road's thick-edged, commanding display letters. Paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-cantarell: Round forms like open parentheses, drawn with a pen-like line of constant weight, give Turret Road its commanding look. Cantarell pulls its c tips well apart, so a long passage feels approachable and unhurried.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-carme: Turret Road is bold and commanding, its round forms resembling open parentheses on a pen-like line. And Carme, a modern sans with open counters, is the one built to carry the longer reading.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-catamaran: Catamaran has curvy letters that feel unclamped and approachable. Turret Road is the one to make a statement with its steady, pressure-free line, while Catamaran handles the quieter work of running text.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-chakra-petch: Hard-edged yet round, Turret Road looks bold and commanding with its parenthesis-like forms. Chakra Petch follows in a plain sans whose cupped letters make the two sit together without friction.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Turret Road bends one constant line into bold, commanding shapes, like cable with no swelling or thinning. Chiron Hei HK brings a wide-open c, like a bracelet pulled apart, so a longer passage in this modern sans reads steadily.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-commissioner: Commanding in mood, Turret Road shapes its round forms like open parentheses on a pen-like line. Commissioner's smooth, unclogged curves are the pair's strongest quality, since every stroke of this sans keeps one thickness.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-dotgothic16: Turret Road's pen-like line of constant weight bends into round forms like open parentheses, which makes it a strong display face. But DotGothic16 is the sans meant for text, with wide channels leading into each counter.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-doto: Doto reads with wide margins of space around each glyph and generous mouths on its round letters. Doto sits under Turret Road's flat, contrast-free forms, so a longer passage feels modern and approachable.
